c: Encoding
A Floorspec document is a JSON text (RFC 8259) encoded in UTF-8.
A document MUST be a well-formed JSON text in UTF-8, without a byte order mark.
An object in a document MUST NOT contain the same member name twice.
A string in a document MUST NOT contain an unpaired surrogate, whether literally or as a
escape.

A canonicalizer MUST produce exactly the canonical form of every valid document it is given.

Content hash
A document's
content hash
identifies its content: equal canonical forms, equal hashes. It is the SHA-256 digest (FIPS 180-4) of the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 serialization of the document after step 1 of
, written as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
A deriver MUST compute a document's content hash as this section defines it.

The hash is taken over the compact RFC 8785 serialization rather than the indented canonical form so that any RFC 8785 library computes it; the two carry the same content, and the hash changes exactly when the canonical form does.
